verdict.rationale: Open WebUI connects to multiple providers (Ollama, OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenAI-compatible) and lets users manually switch models mid-conversation, but nothing in the evidence documents automatic fallback when a model errors or is rate-limited. Manual model switching is an adjacent feature, and Python Functions/Pipes are developer building blocks that could be used to build failover, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As a self-hoster, model failover keeps the assistant working — automatic fallback to another provider or model when one errors or rate-limits
